body: this is broken behavior and should not go out in CR1. needs fixing.

I had to tweak a test in my PR to be ok with that behavior, depending on which one gets first, this test need to be changed:
https://github.com/ia3andy/quarkus/blob/codestarts-v0/integration-tests/devtools/src/test/java/io/quarkus/devtools/commands/AbstractAddExtensionsTest.java#L166
I don't think the tests were changed, so it's hard to find this behavior. Also `mvn quarkus:add-extension -Dextensions="Sm??lRye**"` works in 1.6.1.Final, so this behavior is a bit inconsistent
That I am having a look 😉
